messages:
Ava: Heads-up — got a request from an EU analyst group for a briefing next week. They want embargoed access to the benchmark deck + a short demo. Can we map owners and a timeline?

Diego: Thanks — which analyst group? and what embargo window are they asking for?

Ava: It's 'Northern Insights' (small but covers infra + enterprise). Asking for 24hr embargo after briefing. Prefer Wed 09:00-11:00 CET.

Priya: Wed 09:00 CET works for me to present. I can cover benchmark narrative and nuance on latency/cost tradeoffs.

Sam: I can do the demo at 09:30 CET and handle Qs on runway/rollout. Need final slide deck and bench notes by EOD Monday.

Jordan: Legal flagged a quote review for analyst requests. We need sign-off on any spokesperson quotes before distribution.

Diego: Ok — proposed owner matrix: Priya = deck & benchmark narrative, Sam = demo, Ava = logistics & embargo ops, Jordan = legal sign-off. @PressBot can we schedule the slot and send calendar invite?

PressBot: Calendar invite sent to attendees for 2026-03-25 09:00 CET / 08:00 UTC. Join link: https://meet.company/xyz (auto-created).

Ava: Great. Quick checklist: 1) Draft embargo note & timestamp 2) Deck w/ bench appendix 3) Demo script & recording 4) Approved quote(s) 5) Fact-check packet (data provenance). Who can own fact-check packet?

Priya: I'll assemble the fact-check packet. Will include test harness configs, model versions, hardware profiles, raw latency histograms, and links to eval suites. ETA Mon EOD.

Sam: For quotes, can we do a short pre-approved blurb? Something like: "Redwood Inference enables predictable LLM economics by combining optimized serving and smart routing." Jordan, can legal sign-off that language?

Jordan: That phrasing is fine as long as it doesn't claim benchmarks universally. Suggest adding "in our tests" clause. Proposed: "In our tests, Redwood Inference improves per-token efficiency through serving optimizations and intelligent routing." Approve?

Priya: Approved. I'll drop that into the deck and the embargo note.

Diego: Embargo window: recommend 24 hours post-demo at 08:00 UTC Fri (so journalists can publish Fri morning local). Ava, confirm and I'll include in the embargo language.

Ava: Confirmed — embargo lifts 2026-03-27 08:00 UTC. I'll draft note and share for sign-off by Tue noon.

Sam: One more — Northern Insights often asks for reproducibility details. Priya, can we include a short annex with command-line snippets and package versions?

Priya: Yep. I'll include a small scripts/requirements list and a reproducibility checklist.

Diego: Good. Also planning a short follow-up 1:1 with the lead analyst after the briefing — who wants to join? I can do it + one product person. Priya?

Priya: I can join for 15 minutes.

Ava: All right — action items summarized: Priya: deck, fact-pack, annex; Sam: demo + recording; Jordan: quote/legal sign-off; Ava: embargo note + calendar ops; Diego: follow-up coord. We'll reconvene Tue 13:00 UTC for final readout.

PressBot: Reminder set for Tue 13:00 UTC.

Diego: Thanks team. If you hit blockers (data or compliance), ping me and Jordan immediately. :thumbsup:

Ava: Uploading draft deck now to Marketing Drive — link: https://drive.company/launchsprint/bench-briefing (comments open). Please add inline comments by Mon 17:00.

Priya: Got it, will review and add fact-check links.

Sam: I'll record a dry-run today and share the clip.

Jordan: Will review quotes by EOD Mon.

Diego: Nice work — trying to keep this tight for launch week. :rocket:
